name: tides_provider_gtfs_data_latest
title: tides_provider_gtfs_data_latest
description:
Current-version cut of tides_provider_gtfs_data (`WHERE _is_current`).
Exported to the TIDES bucket at a stable path as the latest
organization <-> feed crosswalk snapshot.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Synthetic version surrogate; unique per record version.

fields.name: organization_source_record_id
fields.description:
Airtable source record ID of the organization. Join key from the
TIDES facts' `organization_source_record_id`.

fields.name: organization_name
fields.description: Organization name.

fields.name: organization_ntd_id
fields.description: National Transit Database ID of the organization.

fields.name: service_source_record_id
fields.description:
Airtable source record ID of the service. Joins to
tides_services.source_record_id.

fields.name: service_name
fields.description: Service name.

fields.name: gtfs_service_data_customer_facing
fields.description: Whether the GTFS service data relationship is customer facing.

fields.name: regional_feed_type
fields.description: Type of regional feed relationship, if any (e.g. Combined Regional Feed).

fields.name: public_customer_facing_fixed_route
fields.description: Whether this record is public, customer-facing, fixed-route service.

fields.name: public_customer_facing_or_regional_subfeed_fixed_route
fields.description:
Whether this record is public fixed-route service that is either
customer-facing or a regional subfeed. This is the eligibility flag
used to select feeds for TIDES publication.

fields.name: schedule_source_record_id
fields.description: Airtable source record ID of the schedule GTFS dataset.

fields.name: schedule_gtfs_dataset_name
fields.description: Name of the schedule GTFS dataset.

fields.name: schedule_gtfs_dataset_key
fields.description: Version surrogate of the schedule GTFS dataset; joins to tides_gtfs_datasets.key.

fields.name: service_alerts_source_record_id
fields.description: Airtable source record ID of the service alerts GTFS dataset.

fields.name: service_alerts_gtfs_dataset_name
fields.description: Name of the service alerts GTFS dataset.

fields.name: service_alerts_gtfs_dataset_key
fields.description: Version surrogate of the service alerts GTFS dataset; joins to tides_gtfs_datasets.key.

fields.name: vehicle_positions_source_record_id
fields.description: Airtable source record ID of the vehicle positions GTFS dataset.

fields.name: vehicle_positions_gtfs_dataset_name
fields.description: Name of the vehicle positions GTFS dataset.

fields.name: vehicle_positions_gtfs_dataset_key
fields.description:
Version surrogate of the vehicle positions GTFS dataset; joins to
tides_gtfs_datasets.key and matches the `gtfs_dataset_key` carried
on the TIDES facts.

fields.name: trip_updates_source_record_id
fields.description: Airtable source record ID of the trip updates GTFS dataset.

fields.name: trip_updates_gtfs_dataset_name
fields.description: Name of the trip updates GTFS dataset.

fields.name: trip_updates_gtfs_dataset_key
fields.description: Version surrogate of the trip updates GTFS dataset; joins to tides_gtfs_datasets.key.

fields.name: _valid_from
fields.description: Timestamp from which this record version is valid (inclusive).

fields.name: _valid_to
fields.description: Timestamp until which this record version is valid.

fields.name: _is_current
fields.description: Whether this is the current version of the record.
